name: glide-select
title: Glide Select
description: A compact dropdown for choosing a sort order: the chosen value sits in a dark chip, and its menu opens below with a highlight that slides from option to option. A tick marks the current choice.
use: A tight toolbar or filter row needs a sort or mode picker without a full-size select.
avoid: It is built for dark surfaces, and the small rows only suit short option labels.
a11y: Full keyboard support with combobox and listbox roles, but the chip and rows show no visible focus ring. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: The grey words Sort issues by sit before a small dark rounded chip holding Last updated and a tiny down chevron. The open menu is a slightly rounded dark panel of five rows, each with a faint letter tag at the right and a tick on the active row.
behaves: Clicking the chip pops the menu out below and flips its chevron up. Moving across or arrowing through rows slides a lighter bar between them; picking a row closes the panel and swaps the chip label with a short blur.
customise: Pass options as strings or value, label and tag objects, plus an aria label. Size, radius, menu width, placement, align, colours, durations and disabled are props.
weight: light: A short list of rows and one sliding span, with nothing running while it is closed.
